content.content:
We need to generate 7-day itinerary for 2 people, leaving Salt Lake City, visiting 3 cities in California between March 25-31 2022. Budget $4600. Need private rooms, smoking permitted. No self-driving, so likely flights, trains, buses. Need to produce plan per day using submit_day_plan function. Must include city, transportation, breakfast, attraction(s), lunch, dinner, accommodation.

We must not ask follow-up. Need to decide cities: maybe Los Angeles, San Diego, San Francisco? That's three. Travel: from Salt Lake City to Los Angeles (flight), then LA to San Diego (train or flight), then San Diego to San Francisco (flight), then back to Salt Lake City? The itinerary is 7 days, so we need day 1 March 25, day 7 March 31. Starting from Salt Lake City day 1 travel to first CA city. Could allocate 2-3 days each city.

Let's outline:

Day 1 (Mar 25): Travel from Salt Lake City to Los Angeles. Flight. Arrival, check-in accommodation (private room, smoking permitted). Breakfast maybe on plane or at airport? We'll list breakfast at "The Original Pantry, Los Angeles". Attractions: maybe Griffith Observatory. Lunch: "In-N-Out Burger". Dinner: "The Smokehouse, Los Angeles". Accommodation: "Hotel Indigo Los Angeles Downtown - Smoking Room".

Day 2 (Mar 26): Full day LA. Breakfast: "The Griddle Cafe". Attraction: "Getty Center, Los Angeles; Hollywood Walk of Fame, Los Angeles". Lunch: "Grand Central Market". Dinner: "Bestia". Accommodation same.

Day 3 (Mar 27): Travel LA to San Diego by Amtrak Pacific Surfliner. Transportation details. Breakfast maybe at hotel or on train "Amtrak Café". Attraction: "Balboa Park, San Diego". Lunch: "Phil's BBQ". Dinner: "Café 222". Accommodation: "The Dana on Mission Bay - Private Smoking Room".

Day 4 (Mar 28): San Diego. Breakfast: "The Mission Café". Attractions: "San Diego Zoo, San Diego; USS Midway Museum, San Diego". Lunch: "Lucha Libre Taco Shop". Dinner: "Ironside Fish & Oyster". Accommodation same.

Day 5 (Mar 29): Travel San Diego to San Francisco by flight. Flight details. Breakfast on flight. Arrival, accommodation: "Hotel Zephyr San Francisco - Smoking Suite". Attractions maybe after check-in: "Fisherman's Wharf, San Francisco". Lunch: "Boudin Bakery". Dinner: "Sotto Mare". Attraction: "Golden Gate Bridge, San Francisco". Accommodation same.

Day 6 (Mar 30): San Francisco full day. Breakfast: "Mama's on Washington Square". Attractions: "Alcatraz Island, San Francisco; Chinatown, San Francisco". Lunch: "Tartine Bakery". Dinner: "House of Prime Rib". Accommodation same.

Day 7 (Mar 31): Return to Salt Lake City from San Francisco. Flight. Breakfast at hotel. Lunch on flight. End.

We need to fill fields: day, current_city, transportation, breakfast, attraction, lunch, dinner, accommodation.

If some fields not applicable, use "-". For day 7, transportation is flight back, maybe no dinner if flight? But we can include dinner: "Dinner on flight". Use "-".

Now we need to call submit_day_plan for each day (7 calls). Ensure fields are strings.

current_city.description: The city for this day. If the plan is to travel between two cities, indicate it as "from A to B" (e.g. "from Ithaca to Charlotte").

transportation.description: e.g. "Flight Number: F3633413, from Ithaca to Charlotte, Departure Time: 05:38, Arrival Time: 07:46"

breakfast.description: The name of a restaurant in the city, e.g. "Nagaland's Kitchen, Charlotte"

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"

accommodation.description: e.g. "Affordable Spacious Refurbished Room in Bushwick!, Charlotte"
